title: Metro inequality change arrows
intent: Show how selected U.S. metros moved in population and wage inequality between 1980 and 2015.

ai.create: Create a quantitative change chart from citywages with one directed arrow per metro from its 1980 population and wage-ratio coordinates to 2015, coloring inequality increases separately from decreases.
ai.maintain: Change the metro selection or arrowhead size while retaining the source endpoint fields, one semantic arrow per metro, and stable identity.
